entities.name: The Doctor
entities.description: A Time Lord who travels anywhere in time and space in the TARDIS; many of the page's quotes come from or are addressed to the Doctor's various incarnations.

entities.name: The First Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who travels in 'that old box' and meets his later replacements.

entities.name: The Second Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who travels with Jamie and calls the TARDIS his home.

entities.name: The Third Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who admires a stegosaurus and knows of Metebelis crystals.

entities.name: The Fourth Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor given to admiring his own brilliance.

entities.name: The Fifth Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who values simple pleasures like flowers and sunsets.

entities.name: The Sixth Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who claims tact and finesse and comes a long way to help the Second Doctor.

entities.name: The Seventh Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who travels with Ace and Mel and bids farewell to Davros.

entities.name: The Eighth Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor.

entities.name: The War Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who decides he has stayed his hand too long.

entities.name: The Ninth Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who celebrates that everybody lives and witnesses the end of the world.

entities.name: The Tenth Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who warns of the stone angels and visited the Medusa Cascade as a child.

entities.name: The Eleventh Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who wears bow ties and took the Seal of the High Council from the Master.

entities.name: The Twelfth Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who vows never to stop looking for an enemy and regains his memories.

entities.name: The Thirteenth Doctor
entities.description: An incarnation of the Doctor who speaks of change, hope and trying again.

entities.name: The Valeyard
entities.description: A prosecutor who promises the court will demand the Doctor's life.

entities.name: Yasmin Khan
entities.description: A companion of the Doctor determined to rescue her.

entities.name: Barbara Wright
entities.description: A companion of the Doctor who forbids any further sacrifice.

entities.name: Rose Tyler
entities.description: A companion of the Ninth and Tenth Doctors.

entities.name: Wilfred Mott
entities.description: A man the Doctor addresses as it being his honor, just before a countdown.

entities.name: Sergeant John Benton
entities.description: A soldier who is no longer surprised by anything the Doctor does.

entities.name: Ace
entities.description: A companion of the Seventh Doctor.

entities.name: Mel
entities.description: A companion of the Seventh Doctor.

entities.name: Jamie McCrimmon
entities.description: A companion of the Second Doctor with a Highland battle cry.

entities.name: The Master
entities.description: A renegade Time Lord and the Doctor's rival, who claims the founding fathers of Gallifrey lied.

entities.name: Missy
entities.description: A version of the Master who mocks cheap time travel and admires a city that turns people into Cybermen.

entities.name: Ian Chesterton
entities.description: A companion of the First Doctor who marvels at the TARDIS and the Aztec city.

entities.name: Peri Brown
entities.description: A companion of the Doctor who can shout as loud as anyone.

entities.name: Sabalom Glitz
entities.description: A man astonished that someone made dragons.

entities.name: Ramo
entities.description: A devotee of the living goddess Amdo.

entities.name: Amdo
entities.description: A living goddess said to see and hear all.

entities.name: Graham O'Brien
entities.description: A companion of the Doctor who always comes prepared.

entities.name: Robin Hood
entities.description: A legendary outlaw who says stories can make us fly.

entities.name: Vrestin
entities.description: A Menoptra reclaiming Vortis.

entities.name: Winston Churchill
entities.description: A wartime leader who tells the Doctor they stand alone with backs to the wall.

entities.name: Tegan Jovanka
entities.description: A companion of the Doctor.

entities.name: Danny Pink
entities.description: A man who wants to see the things in front of him more clearly.

entities.name: Jenny
entities.description: A generated anomaly who loves running.

entities.name: Sally Sparrow
entities.description: A woman who loves old things because they make her sad.

entities.name: Tasha Lem
entities.description: A woman who tells of the Doctor standing protector on Trenzalore.

entities.name: Captain Adelaide Brooke
entities.description: A captain who declares the Biodome Tunnel out of bounds after an infection.

entities.name: Andy
entities.description: A crew member reported infected.

entities.name: Tarak
entities.description: A crew member reported infected.

entities.name: The Fisher King
entities.description: A being who threatens to drain the oceans and chain humanity.

entities.name: Ilin
entities.description: The host of a race to the Ghost Monument on a cruel planet.

entities.name: Clara Oswald
entities.description: A companion of the Doctor who resolves to save the Doctor.

entities.name: Claude
entities.description: A man looking at diamonds poisoned by the sun.

entities.name: Lynda
entities.description: A woman on the Game Station, formerly Satellite Five.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.description: The playwright, who considers using a line from the Doctor.

entities.name: Professor Chronotis
entities.description: A professor who warns of the Sphere, Skagra and Shada.

entities.name: Skagra
entities.description: A figure Professor Chronotis warns against.

entities.name: Dan Lewis
entities.description: A companion of the Doctor asking about a sciencey-spacey plan.

entities.name: Leela
entities.description: A Sevateem warrior and companion of the Doctor who prizes marksmanship.

entities.name: The Great Intelligence
entities.description: An entity heralding a great swarm that will end humanity's celebrations.

entities.name: River Song
entities.description: A woman who speaks of the Towers singing and of a good man going to war.

entities.name: Steadfast
entities.description: A person who believes others want to kill them.

entities.name: Zellin
entities.description: A being who conjures the Chagaskas from people's worst fears.

entities.name: Maebh
entities.description: A girl who loves the forest in Trafalgar Square.

entities.name: Madame Kovarian
entities.description: An enemy of the Doctor who delights in fooling him and foretells a Time Lord's death.

entities.name: Professor Yana
entities.description: An old professor who calls himself an old relic.

entities.name: Gregor
entities.description: A man who questions the Architectural Reconfiguration System.

entities.name: Cobb
entities.description: A man who says whoever holds the Source controls the planet's destiny.

entities.name: Karvanista
entities.description: An ally who plans to ram a ship into the Sontaran fleet.

entities.name: The Abbott
entities.description: An abbot who tells of the Doctor coming to a place of peace.

entities.name: Harrison Chase
entities.description: A man who believes it is now the plants' turn to rule the planet.

entities.name: The Captain
entities.description: A figure declaring a new golden age of prosperity.

entities.name: Bill Potts
entities.description: A companion of the Doctor.

entities.name: Ida Scott
entities.description: A scientist on a rock orbiting a black hole.

entities.name: Todd
entities.description: A person describing Deva Loka as free of predators and disease.

entities.name: Davros
entities.description: An enemy whom the Seventh Doctor bids an unpleasant goodbye.

entities.name: Ruth
entities.description: A woman who grew up in a lighthouse.

entities.name: The Mouri
entities.description: Guardian Priests who maintain the Temple of Atropos.

entities.name: Handles
entities.description: The Eleventh Doctor's companion who put him on a Dalek ship.

entities.name: Time Lords
entities.description: The Doctor's people, builders of the Eye of Harmony.

entities.name: High Council of the Time Lords
entities.description: The ruling council of the Time Lords, who sentence the Doctor to exile.

entities.name: Daleks
entities.description: Enemies who seek to exterminate the Doctor.

entities.description: Worshippers for whom the Pyramid of the Rings of Akhaten is holy.

entities.name: Legion of the Beast
entities.description: A group proclaiming itself the Legion of the Beast.

entities.description: Priests who maintain the Temple of Atropos.

entities.name: Cheetahs
entities.description: Dangerous creatures the Seventh Doctor flees.

entities.name: Aztecs
entities.description: Builders of an extraordinary city.

entities.name: Chagaskas

entities.name: Gallifrey
entities.description: Homeworld of the Time Lords.

entities.name: Death Zone

entities.description: A place the Tenth Doctor visited as a ninety-year-old child.

entities.description: A planet hosting Iceworld.

entities.name: Apalapucia
entities.description: A planet voted a top intergalactic destination.

entities.name: Pyramid of the Rings of Akhaten
entities.description: A holy site for the Sun Singers of Akhat.

entities.name: Vortis

entities.name: Ranskoor Av Kolos
entities.description: A place whose name means Disintegrator of the Soul.

entities.description: Where the Doctor stood as protector of his people and new home.

entities.name: Venezia
entities.description: An impossible, preposterous city.

entities.name: Game Station
entities.description: A station once called Satellite Five.

entities.name: Temple of Atropos
entities.description: A temple on the planet of Time maintained by the Guardian Priests.

entities.name: Deva Loka
entities.description: A planet without predators or diseases.

entities.name: Earth
entities.description: The planet targeted by Sontarans and a mothership.

entities.name: TARDIS
entities.description: The Doctor's time-space machine, a blue box like a police box, and the Second Doctor's home.

entities.name: Seal of the High Council of Gallifrey
entities.description: A seal the Eleventh Doctor took from the Master.

entities.name: The Source
entities.description: A device to rejuvenate a planet's ecosystem that is being fought over.

entities.name: Eye of Harmony

entities.name: Architectural Reconfiguration System
entities.description: A machine that reconstructs particles as needed.

entities.description: A crystal with strange properties that can affect the mind.

events.summary: The High Council of the Time Lords sentences the Doctor to change his appearance and go into exile.
participants: High Council of the Time Lords
events.quote: The time has come for you to change your appearance, Doctor, and begin your exile.

events.summary: The Ninth Doctor rejoices to Rose that everybody lives.
events.quote: Everybody lives, Rose. Just this once, everybody lives!

events.summary: The Master explains he sought vengeance after discovering the founding fathers of Gallifrey lied.
events.quote: They lied to us, the founding fathers of Gallifrey. Everything we were told was a lie.

events.summary: In a recollection, the Eleventh Doctor says he took the Seal of the High Council off the Master in the Death Zone.
participants: Seal of the High Council of Gallifrey
events.quote: Nicked it off the Master in the Death Zone.

events.summary: The Tenth Doctor recalls first coming to the Medusa Cascade as a child.
events.quote: I came here when I was just a kid, ninety years old.

events.summary: The Sixth Doctor comes to aid the Second Doctor, who offers no thanks.
events.quote: "Naturally. Don't expect any thanks," replied the Second Doctor.

events.summary: Tasha Lem recounts the Doctor standing as protector on Trenzalore.
events.quote: On the fields of Trenzalore, he stood as protector both of his own people and his new home.

events.summary: Captain Adelaide Brooke seals the Biodome Tunnel after Andy and Tarak become infected.
events.quote: Biodome Tunnel is out of bounds. Andy and Tarak are infected.

events.summary: Karvanista plans to ram a ship into the Sontaran fleet to erase all Sontarans on Earth.
events.quote: Takes the ships, and all the Sontarans on Earth, out of existence.
You're back! You're in my head. All my memories... are back.

events.summary: The Seventh Doctor bids Davros goodbye.
events.quote: Goodbye, Davros. It hasn't been pleasant.

events.summary: The War Doctor resolves to stay his hand no longer.
events.quote: Too long I have stayed my hand. No more.

events.summary: Madame Kovarian foretells an impossible astronaut rising from Silencio Lake to kill the Time Lord.
events.quote: An impossible astronaut will rise from the deep. And strike the Time Lord dead.

relations.quote: Come on, Ace, we've got work to do!
I think there's something interesting going on there, Mel.
Well... it is a fact, Jamie, that I do tend to get involved.
Find the Doctor! Seek, locate, destroy!
Oh, Doctor. Fooling you once was a joy, but fooling you twice the same way? It's a privilege.
I have to save the Doctor.
Goodbye, Davros. It hasn't been pleasant.

relations.note: Considers himself superior to the Doctor
relations.quote: "But infinitely superior, as I am to that galactic philanthropist," replied the Master.

relations.note: Two incarnations who praise each other
Colony on the dark side of the planet
relations.quote: A space trading colony on the dark side of the planet Svartos
We, the Menoptra, are reclaiming it.
The living goddess Amdo sees and hears all.
It's the TARDIS. It's my home!
Anyway, nothing to do with you surprises me anymore, Doctor.

relations.note: Made from worst fears by his creativity
relations.quote: The Chagaskas. Your worst fears, my creativity.
